findings: 金链 canonicalizes to 粗金链, not 2厘米宽实心粗金链 — the fuller phrase is only in sibling shot_001's body, so resolving it would violate sibling isolation; this is intentional and documented in the commit, but confirm this is the behavior the user actually wants published, since the task text names the fuller phrase explicitly.

Prop registry draws from all context-block prose, not prop-specific clauses — non-prop boilerplate (titles, runtime notes, personality traits) becomes "aliasable" canonical text for other screenplays. Consider scoping the registry to clauses from character/prop-labeled declarations rather than the entire context-only block.

Compound prop values only partially canonicalized — _canonicalize_prop_value applies only its single best-scoring match, while _prop_fact_is_supported chains all applicable alias substitutions. A value naming two distinct short-form props (e.g. "佛珠与金链", which matches this screenplay's own shot_002 phrasing) ends up half-upgraded. Make canonicalization chain replacements the same way validation does, and add a regression case for it.

Phase 2 props_list canonicalization is dead code — p2_data["props_list"] is computed but the final merged shot always sources props_list from Phase 1 only, never from p2_data. Either wire it as a fallback (matching prop_interactions) or drop the unused computation.
